info.title: Sail API
info.description: The register. Every client (POS, back office, guest app, print relay, agents over MCP) calls these operations. All amounts are integer cents. Every mutation needs an Idempotency-Key.

get.description: Liveness and database connectivity. No authentication. Never returns business data.
Returns the caller's principal: type, role, merchant and outlet scope. Use it to decide which buttons to show; the server enforces permissions regardless.

post.description: Development and tests only. Disabled in production.

get.description: Tax mode, GST rate, cash rounding and business-day cutoff for the caller's merchant.
get.summary: Get the merchant and its settings

patch.description: Changes tax mode, GST rate, cash rounding increment or the business-day cutoff. Affects every outlet. Orders already priced keep their snapshot.

post.description: Creates a brand under the merchant.

patch.description: Renames a brand or changes its accent colour; archive by setting archived.

get.description: Outlets the caller can see (their outlet scope).

post.description: Creates an outlet with its hours, UEN and business-day cutoff.

patch.description: Changes an outlet's details, hours, UEN or cutoff.

get.description: POS stations of an outlet with their settings and pairing state.

post.description: Creates a station record for an outlet. Pair an iPad to it with stations.pair.

patch.description: Changes a station's layout, printers, pay-before-firing or seat settings.

get.description: Staff of the merchant with role and outlet scope. PINs are never returned.

post.description: Adds a staff member with a role, outlet and brand scope, optional back-office email and POS PIN.

patch.description: Changes role, scope, PIN or active state.

get.description: Who did what, on which target, when, and who approved it. Filter by actor, action, target or time.
Events for an outlet after a sequence number. This is the source of truth for every live view; the SSE stream only signals that new events exist.
Server-sent events signalling new outlet events and print jobs. Clients catch up with events.list on connect, on a sequence gap, on visibility change and on `resync`.
